title: Sign-Switching Dark Energy: Smooth Transitions with Recent DESI DR2 Observations
summary: Sign-switching dark energy provides a novel mechanism for modifying the late-time expansion history of the Universe without invoking additional fields or finely tuned initial conditions. In this work, we investigate a class of background--level cosmological models in which the dark energy contribution changes sign at a transition redshift $z_\dagger$, producing a sharp deviation from standard $Λ$CDM dynamics.
